verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.170
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.170

verses.pali: 17. Paṭipadāvagga
verses.english: 17. Practice

verses.pali: Yuganaddhasutta
verses.english: In Conjunction

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Ānanda was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There Ānanda addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “āvuso bhikkhave”ti.
verses.english: “Reverends, mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend,” they replied.

verses.pali: Āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
verses.english: Ānanda said this:

verses.pali: “Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṁ byākaroti, sabbo so catūhi maggehi, etesaṁ vā aññatarena.
verses.english: “Reverends, all of the monks and nuns who declare in my presence that they have attained perfection, did so by one or other of four paths.

verses.pali: Katamehi catūhi?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idha, āvuso, bhikkhu samathapubbaṅgamaṁ vipassanaṁ bhāveti.
verses.english: Take a mendicant who develops serenity before discernment.

verses.pali: Tassa samathapubbaṅgamaṁ vipassanaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
verses.english: As they do so, the path is born in them.

verses.pali: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
verses.english: They cultivate, develop, and make much of it.

verses.pali: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṁyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
verses.english: By doing so, they give up the fetters and eliminate the underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṁ samathaṁ bhāveti.
verses.english: Another mendicant develops discernment before serenity.

verses.pali: Tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṁ samathaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
verses.english: As they do so, the path is born in them.

verses.pali: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
verses.english: They cultivate, develop, and make much of it.

verses.pali: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṁyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
verses.english: By doing so, they give up the fetters and eliminate the underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhu samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāveti.
verses.english: Another mendicant develops serenity and discernment in conjunction.

verses.pali: Tassa samathavipassanaṁ yuganaddhaṁ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
verses.english: As they do so, the path is born in them.

verses.pali: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
verses.english: They cultivate, develop, and make much of it.

verses.pali: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṁyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
verses.english: By doing so, they give up the fetters and eliminate the underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, āvuso, bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahitaṁ mānasaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Another mendicant’s heart is seized by restlessness to realize the teaching.

verses.pali: Hoti so, āvuso, samayo yaṁ taṁ cittaṁ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.
verses.english: But there comes a time when their mind is stilled internally; it settles, unifies, and becomes immersed in samādhi.

verses.pali: Tassa maggo sañjāyati.
verses.english: The path is born in them.

verses.pali: So taṁ maggaṁ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
verses.english: They cultivate, develop, and make much of it.

verses.pali: Tassa taṁ maggaṁ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṁyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
verses.english: By doing so, they give up the fetters and eliminate the underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṁ byākaroti, sabbo so imehi catūhi maggehi, etesaṁ vā aññatarenā”ti.
verses.english: All of the monks and nuns who declare in my presence that they have attained perfection, did so by one or other of these four paths.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Paṭipadāvaggo dutiyo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Saṅkhittaṁ vitthārāsubhaṁ,
Dve khamā ubhayena ca;
Moggallāno sāriputto,
Sasaṅkhāraṁ yuganaddhena cāti.
